text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An orientation event for prospective 
students of Tracen Academy will be held 
soon. Its main attraction will be—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The dance stage with me in it is the 
obvious choice! Everyone will be glued to 
my Teio Step~♪
choice_data_list: You're full of confidence, huh
You're full of confidence, huh

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehehehe!! Think it'll go that smoothly~?!
choice_data_list: Full of confidence, I see.
Full of confidence, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan! Are you performing on stage 
too, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The President said before that 
'Orientations are vital opportunities to 
inspire prospective students of this 
academy'—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to hype up the stage 
and become someone the juniors can look
up 
to!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Admiration, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I can't afford to lose either! 
Especially not if the President said so!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best as future upperc...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Let's start the lesson right 
away!!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best as future seniors!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hah, whew...! More, even more... So it 
reaches everyone's hearts...!
choice_data_list: Amazing! That was miles better tha...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! I can't let Tsuru-chan get all the 
cool points! I'll practice a ton and 
become a senior she can really look up 
to~!
choice_data_list: Incredible! It's so much better th...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan...! I... have to do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well,
shall we head back soon? Tsuru-chan, 
what about—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*...
Not yet...! Teio-chan was 
way more amazing than this...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Tsuyoshi! If you get 
exhausted over thisâ future juniors
will 
laugh at you...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: Wanna do a little more practice?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Competing with one another as they 
practiced, the day of the event finally 
arrived! ...Or so it seemed—"
choice_data_list: Want to practice a little more?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Are you guys having a good time? Is 
everyone enjoying the event!?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa,
whoa! Nobody told me Tap-san was running?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Me too! And the crowd is insanely hyped, 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uuu, hang in there, Tsuyoshi!! You're 
gonna be someone your juniors look up to!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But still,
but still... Can we really make 
a stage that tops this one?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. To be honest, it really does sound 
tough, but—
choice_data_list: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had watched from up close just how much 
effort and heart the two of them poured 
into this stage. That's why I told them 
they should be proud of themselves.
choice_data_list: Not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Both of your dances have their own...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... You're right! Both Tsuru-chan 
and I have our own great qualities!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this!?
We'll go up on stage 
together!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tsuru-chan push forward with such 
positivity is frustrating,
but so cool! If 
we clash with everything we've got,
we can totally make it an amazing stage!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan... Wait, is that even allowed??

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If walk-in entries are allowed, then 
entering as a tag team should be fine 
too!!
Putting winning and losing aside for 
a moment—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why don't the two of us try becoming an 
inspiration for our future juniors?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: !! Haha... yeah! Let's do it, Teio-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... They're in perfect sync! That's 
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll shine like the 
upperclassmen once I enter the academy, 
too...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Wonderful~~~! That's some nice dancing! 
I'd love for you to dance with me next 
time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dance of the two captivated the
hearts 
of the crowd, bringing the event to a 
close amidst tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your help this time,
Teio-chan! 
I'm sure the juniors were super happy
with 
it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to thank me! We were 
working toward the same goal anyway!

I've gotta keep working hard as a ...
Everyone was totally captivated by...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to thank me! We were 
working toward the same goal anyway!
choice_data_list: Gotta keep working hard as someone...
You'll have to keep working hard a...
Everyone was totally captivated by...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Though as my Trainer,
you'll have to 
work just as hard as me!
choice_data_list: Gotta keep working hard as someone...
You'll have to keep working hard a...
Everyone was totally captivated by...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's work hard together as 
everyone's role models♪
choice_data_list: Ahaha... Fair point.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, huge success!! We totally became 
the seniors everyone looks up to, right♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... That's right! Yaayyyyyy!!
